This is the way to go! It does solve exactly your issue and provides the functionality you are looking for.

You could also display your widget without any option in a "disabled" state, that way your UI stay the same, just the widget is disabled and the user has the context that given his search, there's no menu items. It's better because you do not hide things automatically.

If this is ok to you, close the issue.

Thanks a lot for participating in this repo!
